summary: Behaviour matches the finding and the fix, but stubs cap this at inconclusive. At 07ffea7f89c5 (latest affected and fix parent), main with --clear_cache kept the seeded three-argument cache entry and returned it without recomputing. At the fix e1d2fa11d657 the same script reached the recomputation probe, so the entry had been invalidated.
what_ran: repro.py imports unmodified eval/compare_q.py with third-party packages stubbed, seeds the test_ppl disk cache through the repository's disk_lru_cache decorator under the key of test_ppl(data_spec, spec, None), registers a probe as data source, loader and forward function, and calls main with clear_cache true.
limits: No model or dataset was used. The stubbed imports are gptqmodel, aqlm, awq, vptq, bitsandbytes, transformers, exllamav2, datasets, matplotlib, adjustText, llama_cpp and gguf, which is why the outcome cannot be reproduced or fix_confirmed. logits_file was None, so a run with an out_logits spec was not exercised. Attempt 001 used an incomplete probe.
modifications: compare_q.get_test_data, load_fns and fwd_fns given a probe that raises on recomputation
sys.argv[0] pointed at a temporary directory so the disk cache stays out of the worktree
Cache entry seeded through disk_lru_cache rather than by a real evaluation
